name: Dientes de Navarino circuit
why: The southernmost trek on Earth: jagged rock teeth, empty lakes and Cape Horn's islands on the horizon.
book: Register with the Carabineros in Puerto Williams before and after. No huts, no services: full camping kit and food for 5 days.
dangers: The route is marked only by cairns: you need a map, GPS and navigation skills.
Snow possible every month; storms off the Southern Ocean.
Steep scree passes (Paso Australia, Paso Ventarrón).
turnaround: Wait out a storm in the forest camps rather than crossing a pass in it.
